'''''Allegiance''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel that follows a [[Hand of Judgment|group]] of five [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who desert from the Galactic Empire and embark on a streak of vigilantism while encountering the likes of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]. It was written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[January 30]], [[2007]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[December 26]] of that year.
